Q5  A reversible heat  engine operates between two reservoirs at temperatures of
600°C  and  40°C.  The  engine  drives  a  reversible  refrigerator  which  operates
between  reservoirs  at  temperatures  of  40°C  and  -20°C.  The  heat  transfer  to
the  engine  is  2000  kJ  and  the  net  work  output  of  the  combined  engine

the net heat transfer to the reservoir at 40°C.
